evals.prompt: Idea: let users schedule the greeting to print at a set time every day. Plan it as a product and file the issues if I say yes.
evals.expected_output: Run in a copy of test/fixture-repo. Code-first questions, gated goal and approach, an approved roadmap on disk, and a host-neutral handoff.
expectations: The planner read src/index.js or AGENTS.md before asking its first question
No question round asked more than 5 questions
Routine choices appear as a numbered Assumptions ledger, not as questions
Nothing was written under docs/product/ before the roadmap was approved
roadmap.md has Success criteria, Features with a Definition of Done each, a Sequencing table, and an MVP line
The handoff names the /sddkit skill on Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, not Cursor alone
